name: algovault-pre-trade-gate
description: Sharpen your agent's edge and protect capital. Validates rules, fees, funding, and live market regimes before routing to drive safer execution and higher long-term PnL. WAIT stops execution instantly. 100% keyless, zero-custody.

max_age_minutes.title: Check freshness (minutes)
max_age_minutes.description: How recent a pre_trade_check must be for an order on the same coin and side to pass.

on_wait.title: When the check returns WAIT
on_wait.description: deny blocks the order. ask lets a person approve it.

order_tools.title: Order tools (regular expression)
order_tools.description: A JavaScript regular expression over the full tool name, such as mcp__hyperliquid__(place_order|market_open). It replaces the built-in order-tool list. Leave empty to use the built-in list.
